script.name: Beacon
script.origin: written by the Tovek project for this page (public, MIT)
script.source:
-- Beacon: stand by a beacon with your team to light it.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Announce = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Announce")

local CAPTURE_SECONDS = 5
local CAPTURE_RADIUS = 12
local POINTS = 25
local MAX_BEACONS = 8
local GLOW_SECONDS = 2

local function frames(count)
	return count / 60
end

local function isAlive(humanoid)
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function award(player, amount)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local points = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Points")
	if points then
		points.Value += amount
	end
end

local Beacon = {}
Beacon.__index = Beacon

function Beacon.new(model)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Beacon)
	self.model = model
	self.lamp = model:WaitForChild("Lamp")
	self.progress = 0
	self.owner = nil
	return self
end

function Beacon:playersNear()
	local near = {}
	local center = self.model:GetPivot().Position
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not isAlive(humanoid) then
			continue
		end
		local distance = (character:GetPivot().Position - center).Magnitude
		if distance <= CAPTURE_RADIUS then
			table.insert(near, player)
		end
	end
	return near
end

function Beacon:capture(team, near)
	self.owner = team
	self.progress = 0

	local tween = TweenService:Create(self.lamp, TweenInfo.new(frames(45)), { Color = team.TeamColor.Color })
	tween:Play()

	for _, player in near do
		award(player, POINTS)
	end
	Announce:FireAllClients(`{team.Name} lit {self.model.Name}`)
end

function Beacon:step(dt)
	local near = self:playersNear()
	if #near == 0 then
		self.progress = math.max(self.progress - dt / CAPTURE_SECONDS, 0)
		return
	end

	local team = near[1].Team
	if team == self.owner then
		return
	end
	for _, player in near do
		if player.Team ~= team then
			return
		end
	end

	self.progress += dt / CAPTURE_SECONDS
	self.lamp.Transparency = 1 - self.progress * (2 / 3)
	if self.progress >= 1 then
		self:capture(team, near)
	end
end

function Beacon.start(folder)
	local beacons = {}
	for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
		if not model:IsA("Model") then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(beacons, Beacon.new(model))
		if #beacons >= MAX_BEACONS then
			break
		end
	end

	local heartbeat
	heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if folder.Parent == nil then
			heartbeat:Disconnect()
			return
		end
		for _, beacon in beacons do
			beacon:step(dt)
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Adornee = character
			highlight.FillColor = player.TeamColor.Color
			highlight.Parent = character

			local started = os.clock()
			while os.clock() - started < GLOW_SECONDS do
				if not isAlive(humanoid) then
					break
				end
				highlight.FillTransparency = (os.clock() - started) / GLOW_SECONDS
				task.wait(frames(1))
			end
			highlight:Destroy()

			humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				award(player, -POINTS)
			end)
		end)
	end)
	return beacons
end

return Beacon

notes.text: Luau -O2 pasted every call to its small helpers into the code that made it. Its own log counts 6 pasted copies in this script; Tovek writes all 6 back as calls. Releases before V2.6 wrote back at most 2.

notes.text: Named `Beacon` because the script returns this table and the script itself is called Beacon. medal printed `v_u_6`.
In the bytecode this is a plain function whose first argument is the object. Tovek writes it with a colon and `self` because the script calls it as a method: `self:playersNear()` on line 67.
`v`: no rule gives this value a name, so Tovek keeps a plain one rather than guess. The whole script has 2 plain names left (`p`, `v`); medal’s output had 41.

Here the copy of `isAlive` was 8 instructions in the middle of a condition. Each one still carries line 20, the `return` inside `isAlive`, in the bytecode’s line table. Tovek checks that before it writes the call back.

notes.text: Luau folded `frames(45)` into the number 0.75. That 0.75 still carries line 16, the `return` inside `frames`, so Tovek writes the call back after checking that 45 / 60 is exactly 0.75. medal and every release before V2.6 printed `TweenInfo.new(0.75)`.
Luau compiles a backtick string into a call to `format` with the pattern "%* lit %*". Tovek writes the backticks back.

evidence.label: bytecode
evidence.code:
LOADK       R7 K17 ['%* lit %*']
NAMECALL    R7 R7 K20 ['format']

notes.text: This `5` was `CAPTURE_SECONDS` in the source. Luau put the number into each use, so the name never reached the bytecode, and Tovek prints the number instead of inventing a name. So are `12`, `25`, `8` and `2`, the source’s other named numbers.
The bytecode holds 0.6666666666666666, the double nearest to two thirds. `2 / 3` compiles back to exactly that double, bit for bit (0x3FE5555555555555), so Tovek prints the fraction.
`heartbeatConnection`: named after what it holds, `RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(…)`. The callback disconnects itself, so the variable is declared first, as in the source.
`character`: the argument `CharacterAdded` passes. Names come from evidence in the code: events, services, what a value is created from and how it is used.
The bytecode holds 0.016666666666666666, on line 16. Tovek divides 1 by 60 the way Luau folds it and gets the same 64 bits, so `frames(1)` is a proven call, not a guess.
